name: lynx_display_pose
description: Entity: Lynx. View or select Lynx's portrait pose or animation on the screen. Poses: 01_standing_smile, 02_talking, 03_look_left, 04_look_right, 05_using_device, 06_singing, 07_dance_000deg... or animation 'dance'.

action.description: Action: 'status' (current selection), 'list' (available poses), 'pose' (set static pose), 'animate' (set animation)
